state:
- The physiologic-uridine efficacy condition is written so a 100 micromolar uridine addition sits inside that arm, which merges a low-micromolar physiologic background with a supra-physiologic rescue and leaves the 100 micromolar figure unlabeled as prior knowledge that still needs checking. Split a measured physiologic-uridine efficacy arm, a uridine-below-1-micromolar arm, and a separate 100 micromolar rescue arm, and require the co-primary maturation signal only at the verified physiologic level.
- Passage and falsification use fixed cutoffs (15 percentage points, 1.0 log2, four of six samples, annexin-V within 10 points) with no assay-variance estimate, no effect-size anchor from the S4 differentiation result, no multiplicity plan, and no locked rule when accrual exceeds six samples. Pre-register paired tests scaled to pilot variance or to the S4 effect and freeze sample size and the success fraction before any sample is scored.
- Selectivity is falsified by a 15-point CD11b, CD15, or CD14 gain on normal CD34-positive cells, while colony output is placed outside the selectivity rule, so on-target pyrimidine stress that shifts normal myeloid markers can retire a true DHODH mechanism. Define selectivity failure as an annexin-V rise together with loss of colony-forming or engraftment capacity, and record normal-cell marker changes as lineage description.
